scripts.start:local: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs local && tsx scripts/check-docker.ts && dotenv -e .env.local -- turbo run start
scripts.start:remote: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs remote && SKIP_DOCKER_CHECK=1 dotenv -e .env -- turbo run start
scripts.dev:local: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs local && tsx scripts/check-docker.ts && dotenv -e .env.local -- turbo run dev
scripts.dev:remote: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs remote && SKIP_DOCKER_CHECK=1 dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs local && dotenv -e .env.local -- turbo run db:generate
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs local && dotenv -e .env.local -- turbo run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs remote && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run db:migrate
scripts.db:deploy:local: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs local && dotenv -e .env.local -- pnpm --dir packages/database run db:deploy
scripts.db:deploy:remote: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs remote && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir packages/database run db:deploy
scripts.db:studio:local: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs local && dotenv -e .env.local -- pnpm --dir packages/database exec prisma studio
scripts.db:studio:remote: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs remote && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir packages/database exec prisma studio
scripts.openapi:csharp: pnpm openapi:generate && npx -y @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate -i apps/api/openapi.json -g csharp -o game-client/Assets/Scripts/Api
